Huey C: Surprise failure during onboarding smoke: /rerank returns 400 "embedding.length mismatch" intermittently.
Ling Z: repro steps?
Huey C: Node sample-app batches ~6 vectors. If an auth refresh triggers a retry, the queued request sometimes contains a vector with length 1535 instead of 1536. Happens ~1/200 runs.
Pat R: are you using Buffer.subarray/TypedArray.subarray anywhere?
Huey C: yes, batch helper uses subarray views to avoid copies. The retry path re-enqueues the exact object reference then some other code mutates the backing buffer.
Ling Z: aha. Python sample-app builds new lists so it never hit this. Short-term patch: clone vectors before enqueue on retry.
Pat R: long-term: the retry middleware should deep-clone bodies or mark them immutable to guarantee safety across helpers. Also add a lint rule warning about using subarray for request payloads.
Huey C: opened PR #4042 with a hotfix that copies buffers before enqueue and a unit test that simulates 401 -> retry + concurrent mutation. CI green locally.
Build Bot: PR #4042 CI: passed \u2705
Ling Z: another UX pain: the error message is too terse. If API returned metadata like batch_index, expected_dim and got_dim that would make debugging much faster.
Platform APIs: We can add optional fields to the error envelope (batch_index, expected_dim, got_dim) in the next minor patch and maintain backward compatibility. SDKs should ignore unknown fields.
Pat R: also noticed subtle parity issue when server-side dedupe reorders outputs. Node helper assumed stable response ordering and tried to re-map by identity; got misaligned when dedupe compressed results. We should consume an explicit input_to_output_map from the server when dedupe occurs.
Platform APIs: Noted. We'll add input_to_output_map to rerank responses when dedupe runs.
Ling Z: action items: 1) merge copy-before-enqueue hotfix (done), 2) implement retry-middleware clone (medium), 3) add SDK lint rule (medium), 4) API error enrich + input_to_output_map (coord with platform), 5) add node+py E2E for batching + retry + dedupe.
Huey C: staging run passed after hotfix. I'll add a short note in the onboarding README: "avoid reusing Buffer/TypedArray views for retriable request bodies; clone if needed."
Pat R: thanks everyone. Leaving issue links in the sample-app repo for follow-ups.
